name: Foam Roller Glute Roll
steps: Sit on the roller with your hands on the floor behind you.
Cross one ankle over the opposite thigh and lean toward the glute on the crossed-leg side.
Roll slowly back and forth across the meaty area of your glute and outer hip.
Adjust the tilt of your torso slightly to find tight spots and pause briefly while breathing steadily.
Continue rolling with control for the duration on one side, then switch legs.
tips: Stay on the fleshy muscle tissue of the glute rather than rolling directly over bony points.
Move slowly so the tissue has time to relax under pressure.
